description: This is a test class for 'DateOrDatetimeEditor', containing unit tests that verify date and datetime parsing and formatting functionalities.

classes.name: DateOrDatetimeEditorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DateOrDatetimeEditor's date parsing and formatting functions.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method to instantiate DateOrDatetimeEditor before each test run.

methods.name: getAsText_shouldPrintDateWithoutTime
methods.description: Test that verifies getAsText outputs date in 'dd/MM/yyyy' format when only date is set.

methods.name: getAsText_shouldPrintDateAndTimeWithTime
methods.description: Test that verifies getAsText outputs date with time in 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' format.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldHandleDate
methods.description: Test that setting text with date string correctly parses and sets the internal value.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldHandleDateAndTime
methods.description: Test that setting text with date and time string correctly parses and sets the internal value.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldFailOnPartialDate
methods.description: Test that setAsText throws IllegalArgumentException on partial date input.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldFailOnPartialDateAndTime
methods.description: Test that setAsText throws IllegalArgumentException on partially complete date and time input.
